name: Hushcaster
behaviour: Stays ten to fourteen metres back and opens a signal link to the hero. If the link holds for 1.3 s it locks one hero skill for 7 s and drains 30 mana. A wall in the way, a heavy hit, a parry or distance breaks the link. Blinks away when the hero closes in.
look: Tall, thin signal engineer in a violet suit with a satellite dish for a head and magenta-tipped antennae.
